title: Slabs with sloping soffits.
officialText:
The thickness of slabs with sloping soffits (see Figure 721.2.2.1.2) shall be determined at a distance 2t or 6 inches (152 mm), whichever is less, from the point of minimum thickness, where t is the minimum thickness.
For SI: 1 inch = 25.4 mm
